title: Injection trace event state
description: Shape of the `state` field for injection-attacks trace events.

config.description: Global switches the application has flipped so far.

escapeQuotes.description: Whether concatenated SQL doubles every quote in the value first.

xmlDoctype.description: Whether the XML parser still accepts DOCTYPE declarations.

statement.description: The statement or document being traced (null before the first one).

language.description: Which grammar is about to parse the text; untranslated.

binding.description: How the untrusted value was combined with the statement; untranslated.

template.description: The expression as it appears in the application source.

text.description: The finished text handed to the parser.

input.description: The untrusted value exactly as it arrived.

channel.description: Whether the value travelled inside the statement text, beside it, or never reached it.

tokens.description: What the parser made of the text: one entry per SQL token or XML line.

kind.description: The role the parser assigned to this fragment; untranslated.

fromInput.description: Whether any of these characters came from the untrusted value.

danger.description: Whether untrusted characters became grammar here instead of staying a value.

result.description: What running the statement produced (null before it runs).

kind.description: A result set, or a single message (an error, a file's contents).

rows.description: Result rows, each a list of values matching `columns` by position.

text.description: The message when `kind` is text; null otherwise.

outcome.description: How far the current statement got and what it ended up meaning.

stage.description: Progress: text built, text parsed, verdict final.

injected.description: Whether the untrusted value left its slot and became part of the grammar.

impact.description: What the rewritten statement achieved; untranslated.

blockedBy.description: Which mechanism kept the value data; null when nothing did or nothing had to.

stats.description: Running totals across the whole run.

injections.description: Statements where untrusted characters became grammar.

leaked.description: Statements that returned data the caller had no right to.

stayedData.description: Statements where a defence kept the value a value.
